content:
sarah-support: Heads-up: multiple customers reporting 502/504s on /v1/rerank during 11:25-11:40 PDT. p95 spiked ~3x. Attaching sample payload and notes.

alex: Can you paste a representative request + any gateway logs? Any common payload pattern? :eyes:

sarah-support: Sample we captured (redacted IDs). Notice candidate_count ~200 and payload ~1.2MB.
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"query": "best items", "candidates": ["id_1","id_2", ... "id_200"] }'
```

morgan: We're seeing gateway timeout = 15s hit and 502s returned from rerank-backend with "handler timeout". Lots of gateway retries piling up. Snippet from gateway logs: 
```
2026-11-02T18:27:11Z WARN gateway request_id=xyz backend=rerank status=502 backend_msg="handler timeout"
2026-11-02T18:27:11Z INFO gateway retry request_id=xyz attempt=2
```

eng-oncall-bot: Alert: rerank-service p95 latency 11.8s; queue_length=242; pods=4->6 (scale triggered)

priya: Autoscale lagging because HPA cooldown is 60s; during bursts we get queueing. Also the scoring path is O(N) per request — 200 candidates -> huge fanout.

dan: Hypothesis: large candidate lists + gateway retry loop + synchronous KV cache misses = thundering herd. Repro steps below (staging):
```bash
# run from loadgen box
ab -n 5000 -c 50 -p big_payload.json -T application/json https://staging.api.redwood/v1/rerank
# big_payload.json uses candidates ~200
```

alex: Reproduced in staging at lower scale: p95 jumps as soon as avg candidates > ~75. KV cache miss rate jumps from ~3% to ~65% (inspected cache logs).

morgan: Immediate mitigations I propose:
- reduce gateway max_retries to 1 with exponential backoff/jitter
- enable fast-fail for candidate_count > 150 (429) while we add server-side trimming
- add a per-request batch cap in the ranking workers to limit internal fanout

priya: I'll lower the HPA cooldown to 20s for the rerank namespace and add a predictive autoscale rule for the 11:00-12:00 window. ETA ~2h to roll config.

sarah-support: Notifying affected customers with suggested client-side changes (reduce concurrency, add jitter/backoff). Any billing/auth implications? Customers reported only application errors and retries; no auth failures or billing breaks so far.

dan: Long-term ops items: implement a fast approximate fallback scorer for high-N requests, server-side trimming policy (keep top-K candidates before heavy scoring), and instrument KV cache to surface miss patterns to the console.

alex: Action items: @morgan update gateway config (max_retries=1 + jitter) and add fast-fail rule; @priya change HPA cooldown + predictive rule; @dan collect traces + KV cache hit histograms; @sarah-support continue customer comms. I'll write an RFC for the fallback ranker.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: rerank-gateway-config change (max_retries=1) rolled at 11:58 UTC

sarah-support: Thanks — monitoring now. Will close once p95 stays <5s for 30m :thumbsup:
